summary: Tested TranslateBox Live backend (health + realtime-session error handling) and frontend Console + Debug flows. All 11 requested scenarios pass. Backend returns 200 on /api/health with openai_key_configured=false and model=gpt-realtime-translate; /api/realtime-session returns 503 with a clear OPENAI_API_KEY message. Frontend renders header 'TRANSLATEBOX LIVE', French->English, audio device selector with 3 fake devices, four status dots, timer 00:00:00, START triggers backend POST and shows dismissible human-readable error banner ('Could not start a translation session. OPENAI_API_KEY is not configured...'), START button restored after failure (no crash/freeze), MUTE toggles label between MUTE TRANSLATED AUDIO / TRANSLATED AUDIO MUTED, RESET keeps timer at 00:00:00, theme toggle flips html.dark class (dark->light), /debug page loads via nav link, exposes logs+events tabs and back link that returns to /, transcript panels + text testids all present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/realtime-session forwards raw OpenAI error body to client via HTTPException detail; consider sanitizing to avoid leaking upstream internals when a real key is added.
server.py: CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router; works in FastAPI but conventional order is to add middleware before including routers.
Consider adding a lightweight rate limit on POST /api/realtime-session once key is configured to avoid abuse of ephemeral secret minting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OPENAI_API_KEY is intentionally empty. When the key is added, retest /api/realtime-session for 200 + ephemeral 'value' field and full WebRTC handshake path in translationEngine.js. All data-testids validated: audio-device-select, status-{mic,openai,translation,network}-dot, session-timer-display, start-translation-button, error-banner, dismiss-error-button, mute-audio-button, reset-session-button, theme-toggle-button, debug-nav-link, debug-tab-logs, debug-tab-events, debug-back-link, original-transcript-panel/text, translated-transcript-panel/text.
